verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a SaaS work-management product like Jira, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no first-party or community mention of a sandbox, staging, or isolated test environment that keeps production data untouched. Items on APIs, configuration and marketplace apps are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
